evidence.map_render_shape: chargerMap receives a chargers collection and maps each item after splitting geo_coordinates

map_center_seen.classification: static map center only; not a station

finding.summary: The public FastVolt web client contains a real chargerMap renderer that expects a chargers collection with geo_coordinates. The currently validated /api/pages schema and NewQuery/fastvoltsections path do not expose that collection, so the station inventory is injected or fetched through a still-unidentified path.
finding.blocker: Identify the producer of the chargerMap chargers prop from public client assets or a public read-only request path before attempting any new station endpoint probe.
do_not_infer: Do not treat /api/pages as the national station feed.
Do not treat fastvoltsections/NewQuery as the national station feed.
Do not interpret the static Morocco map center as a charging station.

tcc_modeling.status_source: FastVolt native when a station feed is validated

next_safe_step: Trace only the chargerMap prop producer and nearby public request/function identifiers in the already-public same-origin client bundle; avoid endpoint guessing, auth probing or session actions.
